regions.finding: Three generic regioselectivity rules are explicitly contextualized as earlier work [5c]; recorded as literature_example, not as experiments of this paper.

regions.region: upper-right, Scheme 2 and surrounding mechanistic discussion
regions.finding: Proposed propargyl-palladium and allenyl-palladium pathways leading to alkyne and allene regioisomers; classified as two mechanism records, not experimental yields.

With [Pd(PPh3)4] in THF, the propargylic mesylate furnished 3a while corresponding carbonate and acetate substrates did not react at room temperature; the two failed substrate screens were recorded separately.
Narrative corroborates ligand-controlled regioselectivity and no-reaction behavior; it also reports 45% for L5 versus 43% in Table 1, so both source values and the discrepancy were retained.

unresolved: Scheme 1 and Scheme 2 use generic R groups and do not provide individual experimental quantities.
The carbonate and acetate no-reaction statements lack duration, exact structures, catalyst loading, workup, and expected-product identities.
Table 1 entry 9 has an unresolved source discrepancy: 43% in the table versus 45% in the narrative.

regions.region: upper-left, Table 1 reaction header, rows 1-9, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Nine independent optimization conditions were transcribed. Footnote additives iPrOH, PhOH, and added PPh3 are structured participants at 10 mol%; entry 7 is NR. Visual inspection establishes entry 6 as 9 h and 59% despite faulty text extraction.

regions.region: upper-right, Table 2 reaction header, rows 1-12, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Twelve substrate-scope rows were inventoried; Table 2 entry 2 duplicates Table 1 entry 5 and is merged into one record. Entry 10 yield targets the printed 3f+4f pair; all other yields target the product label printed in parentheses. Entry 12 uses bromide rather than mesylate.

regions.region: center-right, Scheme 3 reaction arrow and the two ligand-specific result lines
regions.finding: Two distinct PhZnBr coupling runs were recorded: PPh3 gives 74% with 5:6=9:1, while L3 gives 77% with 5:6=1:8.

Pd2(dba)3 and PdCl2 are said to preserve ligand-dependent regioselectivity, while CH2Cl2, CH3CN, DMF, and 1,4-dioxane give complicated results. Each distinct named condition is retained as an unresolved record because row-level ratios, yields, and ligand assignments are absent.

General 1b procedure gives catalyst/ligand pre-stirring at room temperature for 20 min, organozinc addition, overnight reaction, aqueous/ether workup, MgSO4 drying, and silica chromatography with hexane/ether 50:1; applied to the detailed 3b and 4b records only.

unresolved: Yield measurement basis and reaction atmosphere are not reported for the tabulated entries.
Table 2 entry 1 numerically resembles Table 1 entry 1 but depicts a different catalyst system, so the two are retained separately pending human review.
Alternative-precatalyst and solvent-screen prose lacks row-level ligand, yield, ratio, time, and quantity assignments.
No supporting information file was explicitly provided or associated.

regions.region: upper-left, detailed preparation and characterization of 3b
regions.finding: The 1b/2/[PdCl(pi-C3H5)]2/PPh3 experiment gives 41.4 mg (68%) of 3b; masses, mmol, solution volume/concentration, solvent volume, and product mass were merged into Table 2 entry 3.

regions.region: upper-left, detailed preparation and characterization of 4b
regions.finding: The 1b/2/[PdCl(pi-C3H5)]2/L3 experiment gives 60.4 mg (82%) of 4b; explicit amounts were merged into Table 2 entry 4. The page-3 quantities show 0.46 mmol 2 for 0.23 mmol 1b and therefore override the approximate 1.5-equiv scheme header for this run.
